title: context_compact and critique execute
description: Two of the six never-executed nodes are unreachable simply because no committed case drives them. Add cases that do.

successCriteria.description: A golden case drives context_compact to execution, and the node's span status is 'ok'.
A golden case drives critique to execution, and the node's span status is 'ok'.
Both leave NEVER_EXECUTED, and the list's two-directional guard still fails if either silently re-enters.
The new cases are enforcement=replay, not integrity — an integrity case makes no runtime claim and would not prove execution.
Full suite, typecheck, typecheck:tests, lint and build green, and the golden gate passing at or above its replay floor.

stopConditions: A node turns out to be unreachable for a structural reason rather than a missing case — record which, with the reason, rather than contriving a case that reaches it artificially.
definitionOfDone: All required criteria met, the full suite plus typecheck, typecheck:tests, lint and build green, the golden gate passing, and every documentation claim added backed by a test that fails when the claim stops being true.
generatorNotes: Coverage counts a node as executed only when its span status is ok (that rule was tightened by sprint 9 of spec-20260812-pge-real-workload-errors — a failed span no longer counts). The NEVER_EXECUTED list at src/pge/golden/coverage.test.ts:139-146 is a list of CLAIMS about why each node is unreachable; deleting an entry means its claim stopped being true, so delete deliberately. Capture with GOLDEN_CAPTURE=1. Run the suite as `npx vitest run --exclude '**/.claude/worktrees/**' --exclude '**/node_modules/**'` — a bare run picks up nested worktrees. Verify on a CLEAN checkout, not just the working tree: this repo has twice been green locally and red in CI because uncommitted state was carrying the result.
evaluatorNotes: Confirm the new cases are genuinely replay cases and that the nodes' spans are 'ok' rather than merely present. A case that reaches a node but errors inside it does not satisfy this sprint. Run the suite as `npx vitest run --exclude '**/.claude/worktrees/**' --exclude '**/node_modules/**'` — a bare run picks up nested worktrees.
